content.friendMessage: anyone want to build a castle later?
content.message: FREE 10,000 COINS for the first 5 players!! Log in with your BlockCraft username and password at my site. Hurry, only 2 spots left!!

do.text: You typed in your password. The next day, you can't log in. Someone took your account and all your items.

ignore.text: You kept your account safe. But your friend Mia clicked the link, and now her account is gone.

tell.text: Dad helped you report the player and warn your friends in chat. Nobody lost their account!

buddy.intro: Look, someone is posting in game chat!

do.text: Oh no! Let's see what happened.

ignore.text: You're safe, but the scammer is still in the chat.

tell.text: Awesome! A grown-up helped stop the scam!

stop.text: 'Only 2 spots left' was trying to make you rush.

check.text: Free stuff that sounds too good to be true usually isn't real.
A real game will never ask for your password in chat.
Look closely: this name uses zeros instead of O's to look official.
This link isn't the real BlockCraft website.

recap.tell: Show a grown-up and say: 'Someone in game chat is offering free coins. Is it real?'
